kicker: An ink scroll from 1950 to today, then a stone path into the mist.
summary: Over 70 years and a few winters, AI reached chatbots and agents; mist still lies ahead.

quiz.q: Which of these is still a prediction that hasn’t happened?
quiz.explain: ASI is still a hypothesis; the other three happened in 1997, 2017 and November 2022.

scroll.label: The scroll
scroll.region: A scroll of AI history. Drag, scroll the mouse wheel or use the left and right arrow keys to move between milestones.

insight.text: Over 70 years: small steps, a few winters, then a very fast speed-up.

caption.text: Alan Turing asked, “Can machines think?” and proposed a test.
A summer workshop at Dartmouth College (USA) launched the field of artificial intelligence.
Twice, around 1974 and 1987, hopes outran results, and money and interest in AI dropped sharply.
IBM’s Deep Blue computer beat world chess champion Garry Kasparov.
AlexNet learned from over a million images and won an image-recognition contest by a wide margin.
DeepMind’s AlphaGo beat top Go player Lee Sedol 4–1 in Seoul.
The paper “Attention Is All You Need”: the machine “pays attention” to every word at once.
OpenAI unveiled GPT-3: with just a few examples, it could handle quite a lot of new tasks.
Nov 30, 2022: ChatGPT launched — chat with AI in plain words, and anyone can try it.
Reasoning models like OpenAI o1 “think” step by step before answering.

events.title: AI agents and the MCP standard

caption.text: AI agents carry out many steps on their own; MCP became a shared standard for connecting AI to tools.

future.label: Ahead
future.group: Five stones in the mist, from near to far
future.insight: These are ideas and predictions, not events; the further from today, the thicker the mist.

caption.text: Hand over a big goal; the agent splits up the work, uses tools, and keeps going for hours.
AI forms its own hypotheses, runs experiments, and discovers new things like medicines or materials.
AI helps improve AI itself; each better version improves faster: a speed-up loop.
Can do most thinking work the way humans can. There’s no agreed definition yet.
Far beyond the best humans in nearly every field. For now, only a hypothesis.

views.label: Points of view
views.insight: No one knows the timing for sure. Hear all three sides and trust information with sources.

view.text: It’s coming soon, and the benefits will be huge: curing diseases, speeding up science.
AI is getting stronger fast, so we need safety and clear rules first.
It’s still far off: today’s AI is good at stringing words together but doesn’t truly understand the world.
